steps: Find an ecoATM kiosk near you
Get an offer at the kiosk (or lock it online for up to seven days)
The kiosk validates the device automatically
Accept and get paid immediately: cash, Venmo, or PayPal
timing: Immediate payment at the kiosk (cash, Venmo, or PayPal); online offer lock up to seven days.
who_pays: ecoATM - the kiosk pays you directly on the spot, in cash, Venmo, or PayPal.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+ with a valid government ID (the kiosk photographs you and records the transaction), and you must own the device. You need to physically reach an ecoATM kiosk in the US.
work_available: Yes - ecoATM kiosks were operating in the US as of 2026-09-23 (find one near you with the kiosk locator on ecoatm.com). You can lock an online offer for up to seven days before visiting.
what_gets_accepted: The kiosk's automated validation is final - if it finds issues, the offer drops or the device is rejected on the spot. Kiosk pricing runs well below what a private buyer or mail-in buyback would pay, so this is best for damaged or low-value phones.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Your unpaid time is traveling to a kiosk and waiting for the validation - there is no shipping, packing, or multi-day inspection.
when_cash_arrives: Real money immediately - cash, Venmo, or PayPal paid on the spot at the kiosk the moment you accept the offer.
